domain.text: Software engineering: agent-workflow tooling and task onboarding

impressions.text: The codexbal/gpt-6.1-sol delivery covered task-only PR bodies, generated worker onboarding, and model sourcing from the PR card.
The worker reported broad test and build verification, then integrated the moved base while preserving both sides’ behavior and reported green checks.
The worker appropriately stopped at an orchestrator-only live-smoke step; the orchestrator later reported that a luna worker reached READY from the first prompt without nudges.
The owner asked how adopters would locate the worker guide, and the orchestrator clarified the package path for adopters versus the repository-local path for vmethod itself.

roundCauses.text: Review round 1 required merging the moved origin/dev base because the branch conflicted, followed by full checks and a push.
